result.topic_en: Binomial expansions of powers of $(g+m\lambda)$ with exponents $\lambda$ and $\lambda-1$, and the start of an expression for $((g+m\lambda)^{\lambda-1}-1)/\lambda$; faint bleed-through from the reverse side is not transcribed.
result.transcription:
$(g+m\lambda)^{\lambda+1}$
$(g+m\lambda)^{\lambda} = g^{\lambda}$ [-$+ m\lambda\cdot\lambda g^{\lambda-1} + (m\lambda)^2\cdot\lambda\cdot\frac{\lambda-1}{2} g^{\lambda-2}$-]
$(g+m\lambda)^{\lambda-1} = g^{\lambda-1} + m\lambda\cdot(\lambda-1)\,g^{\lambda-1} + (m\lambda)^2\cdot\frac{(\lambda-1)(\lambda-2)}{1\cdot 2}\,g^{\lambda-2}$

$\frac{(g[-m-]+m\lambda)^{\lambda-1}-1}{\lambda} = a$ [-$+$-] $m$ [-$\lambda-1$-][?]
